summary.short: Amends Regulation (EU) 2021/1173 to give the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking legal basis to establish and operate AI gigafactories, with Union co-financing, hosting, procurement, access and governance rules. Also expands quantum provisions. Applies from the day after Official Journal publication.
summary.long: Amends Regulation (EU) 2021/1173 to give the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking a legal basis to establish and operate AI gigafactories: large AI computing facilities with supporting data centre, storage, networking and secure cloud access, located in a Member State. Each is financed by a partnership of the Joint Undertaking, a consortium and Participating States. The Union contributes up to 17% of computing CAPEX or a guaranteed access-time purchase, matched by Member States, who may channel Recovery and Resilience Facility funds through the Joint Undertaking. Selection is by joint procurement and evaluation criteria including energy efficiency. Entities from non-Participating States may be restricted from consortia. Hosting Agreements must cover governance, access, audits and liability, and certain ownership or control changes require prior approval from a public governance body. Member State-provided access time is used mainly for start-ups and SMEs. The amendment also expands the quantum pillar, sets up a Quantum Technologies Advisory Group, adjusts Governing Board voting and raises the Union contribution to EUR 4 122 300 000. It contains no sanction provisions and applies from the day after Official Journal publication.

“Artificial Intelligence gigafactory” or “AI gigafactory” means a state-of-the-art large-scale facility with sufficient capacity to handle the complete lifecycle, from development to large-scale inference, of very large AI models and applications

definitions.term: Artificial Intelligence gigafactory Consortium / AI gigafactory Consortium

evidence.quote: “Artificial Intelligence gigafactory Consortium” or “AI gigafactory Consortium” means an association of eligible legal entities forming a consortium and bound by a consortium agreement
“AI gigafactory Coordinator” means a legal entity, duly incorporated in the Union and validly existing under the laws of the Member State in which it is established
“AI gigafactory Hosting Agreement” means an agreement between the Joint Undertaking and the AI gigafactory Coordinator to host and operate an AI gigafactory

“AI gigafactory hosting entity” means a legal entity which has been designated by an AI gigafactory Consortium to host and operate an AI gigafactory and its services, and which is established in a Participating State that is a Member State
“Artificial Intelligence gigafactory Cooperation Agreement” is an agreement between the Joint Undertaking and a third country specifying eligibility of participation in an AI gigafactory Consortium
“a multi-site single-country AI gigafactory” is an AI gigafactory deployed in more than one physical location within the territory of one Member State
“a multi-site multi-country AI gigafactory” is an AI gigafactory deployed in more than one physical location and in the territories of more than one Member State
“National Quantum Competence Centre” means a legal entity, or a consortium of legal entities, established in a Participating State
under Regulation (EU) 2021/241 (“RRF allocations”)

enforcement.note: The text sets out no sanction regime: no fines, penalties, criminal sanctions, licence revocation, benefit clawback, suspension or blocking. Art. 12b(16) requires the Governing Board to take corrective action on access-time imbalances, and Art. 12b(17)(k) has the Hosting Agreement list liability conditions, but neither is a sanction regime.
